description: This file contains unit tests for the FrameType template class, including setting and getting buffers, copying data, and using nested reader/writer classes.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A template class representing a data frame with buffer management, supporting nested reader/writer classes.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets data buffer at a specified offset with a given length and source array.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves data buffer from a specified offset with a given length into a destination array.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns or sets the size of the frame buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears or resets the frame buffer.
